title: Waterpark
content: Is the waterpark / amusement park now flooded in others dreams? I used to go there more often when i was younger but i cannot go now because of the flood, unless i have a dream about when I was younger and go as a kid. Weirder though is that I had friends that used to go there with me that no longer show up elsewhere in my mall world. Thank god recently I was able to leave the grocery store though. Currently i have been more stuck in my busted house trying to fix it and the neighborhood its in. I havent been to the mall in a while. But i have been upto the college to shop and go to the library because its a duel purpose in my realm / dream. My favorite areas are the downtown area where its all different ages of buildings including old. Where they put stores and chilling areas all through the upstairs and roofs that connect around the city. Or the coast, where the ocean is. Or the lake area that may or may not be connected to the ocean that has a major national park with flooded bridges, or the campground and gas station out in the country. I travel whenever I can be more "lucid" and control where i am.. Even though the world is still very much alive and moving around me with 100s of others doing their daily. Many seemingly unaware. Except a few. We are mostly outcasts and just try to blend in anymore though its hard to place faces. Im missing my favorite friend though for years and have been searching for them for a long time. I know all this sounds crazy to most people not sharing these dreams, but i wasnt even aware others shared these dreams until recently.. In my dream they said i might not see them again and i never did. So now im curious if they ever were a real person perhaps? If so, are they still alive?. Or Did they go through some type of emdr or hypnosis to stop it? With that said. I figured just for shits and giggles to go looking around posts wherever i can. I need to sit down and try to make it in some type of software like minecraft so i can share it.
